findings.title: General relative Tits alternative lacks central-quotient closure
locations: Corollary 3.3 invoked for general C on p.25
findings.source_claim: C contains Z and is closed under isomorphisms, subgroups, extensions and finite-index supergroups; peripheral relative alternatives imply Out(G,F(t)) relative alternative.
findings.complete_check: C=groups with bounded orders of finite-order elements. Bounds multiply under extensions and multiply by subgroup index under finite-index supergroups. E_n=Z^n semidirect Z via n-cycle is torsion-free with centre {(c*1,n*k)}. A=direct_sum E_n is countable torsion-free and all its subgroups are in C. A/Z(A) contains L=direct_sum C_n, abelian with unbounded torsion orders. For G=A*C2 and F={[A],[C2]}, partial conjugations embed A/Z(A) in Out(G,F(t)); kernel verified exactly Z(A). Thus L violates conclusion. Theorem6.2 has Ai=1 and all its hypotheses hold.
counterevidence: All finitely generated subgroups of L are finite; the manuscript explicitly requires all subgroups.
Infinite generation is allowed within one of the two peripheral factors.
Classical virtually solvable and virtually polycyclic classes handle central quotients.
Additional Out(A) assumption for Theorem6.1 not verified, so that theorem is not directly refuted.
findings.impact: False core relative generalization and invalid sporadic induction base; 6.2 and 6.3 refuted, ordinary Tits alternative and applications not refuted.

repair.statement: Add closure of C under quotients by arbitrary central subgroups.
repair.verified: Proved passage of relative alternative B -> B/Z: a rank-two free subgroup in the preimage intersects central Z trivially; otherwise quotient is in C.
repair.boundary: Local quotient step only; no complete corrected general theorem or journal-version claim.

scope_clarifications.result: Main Out(G,F(t)) is countable by finite tuple of conjugators and basis images. For general H, countable selection preserves absence of finite proper-free-factor orbits; proof of5.6 uses only this condition. No separate rated finding.

unresolved_claims: External in-preparation tree-stabilizer input not independently checked

focused_scientific_check.scope: Independent focused checks of existing reported Problems only; no full initial review, unrelated issue search, new author-code execution or new compilation.
focused_scientific_check.computation_reuse: Existing reviewer-created scripts and outputs were read and reused with current byte hashes. The native helper independently checked the analytic arguments and did not rerun these scripts.

checks.reason: The pinned arXiv v2 definitions quantify all subgroups and permit infinitely generated countable peripherals. Bounded finite-order-element orders form a class with every listed closure property: extension bounds multiply and finite-index enlargement multiplies by at most the index. E_n=Z^n semidirect Z is torsion-free with centre {(c*1,nk)}, so the countable direct sum A has A/Z(A) containing abelian direct_sum C_n outside the class. Partial conjugations in A*C2 have kernel exactly Z(A), furnishing the bad subgroup without relying on an external proposition. Theorem6.2 with trivial Ai and6.3 fail; the additional Out(A) hypothesis of6.1 and the unacquired journal version are not asserted. Closure under arbitrary central quotients verifies only the claimed local repair.
